clips.notes: Google FLEURS test split (CC-BY-4.0), en_us. Sentence ids 1661..1664, the same FLoRes-101 sentences in every language, so clips are parallel across en/zh/ja and the references are FLoRes human translations rather than machine output. Caveat: FLEURS utterances are independently read single sentences, so this clip concatenates unrelated sentences - the topic changes roughly every 10 s, and an ASR endpoint always coincides with a sentence end, which flatters punctuation restoration compared with continuous speech.
